value_stream.name: Mandatory Discount, Eligibility & Tax Credit Recovery

workflows.name: PEZA/BOI VAT-Zero-Rated Sale Customer Onboarding & Certificate Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Trade Sales obtains PEZA/BOI Certificate of VAT Zero-Rating and" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validates certificate currency and scope" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-compile of "compiles zero-rated sales schedule monthly for 2550M" (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Audit risk**: Expired certificate disallows zero-rating; mitigated by annual renewal tracking
System Touchpoints: - Customer master VAT treatment; certificate repository; 2550M schedule

steps.activity: Trade Sales obtains PEZA/BOI Certificate of VAT Zero-Rating and registration at account setup; AR stores in customer master
Tax Accountant validates certificate currency and scope; configures VAT-zero-rated treatment in customer/item tax code; audits renewal calendar
Tax Accountant compiles zero-rated sales schedule monthly for 2550M; defends input VAT refund with BIR

fields.Trigger: Government agency or diplomatic mission purchase

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validates exemption scope and authority" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "AR archives exemption documentation" (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Processing exemption without proper certificate forfeits output VAT; mitigated by documentation gate
System Touchpoints: - VAT-exempt sale processing; exemption certificate archive

steps.activity: Trade Sales obtains tax-exempt certification: government agency DOM (Department Order/Memorandum), diplomatic VAT exemption certificate from DOF/BIR
Tax Accountant validates exemption scope and authority; processes sale as VAT-exempt; captures exemption reference in invoice
AR archives exemption documentation; supports BIR audit of government/diplomatic VAT-exempt sales

fields.Trigger: Sale to accredited school or low-cost housing developer

workflows.name: Educational Institution & Housing (PAG-IBIG) VAT-Exempt Sale Processing

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-validate of "validates accreditation and price threshold" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-count of "Accountant compiles exempt-sales schedule for 2550M" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-485 (ensure controlled execution — VAT-Exempt & Zero-Rated Customer Certification (PA-85.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Wrong threshold application; mitigated by price-threshold validation

steps.activity: Trade Sales obtains DepEd/CHED accreditation for schools (educational materials VAT-exempt) or PAG-IBIG/DHSUD accreditation for low-cost housing (≤ PHP 3.2M threshold)
Tax Accountant validates accreditation and price threshold; applies VAT-exempt treatment to qualifying materials/sales
Tax Accountant compiles exempt-sales schedule for 2550M; defends position with BIR

fields.Frequency: Event-driven; low volume in hardware retail
fields.Trigger: Sale of agricultural/fisherfolk inputs to qualified buyer

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-register of "registered farmer/fisherfolk cooperative or individual per RA 8435" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-count of "Accountant applies VAT-exempt treatment to qualifying agricultural/fisherfolk…" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "documents basis for exemption" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-485 (ensure controlled execution — VAT-Exempt & Zero-Rated Customer Certification (PA-85.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Mis-applied agri/fisherfolk exemption; mitigated by qualification verification

steps.activity: Trade Sales verifies buyer qualification (registered farmer/fisherfolk cooperative or individual per RA 8435) and eligible-input scope
Tax Accountant applies VAT-exempt treatment to qualifying agricultural/fisherfolk inputs; captures buyer reference
Tax Accountant includes in 2550M exempt schedule; documents basis for exemption

fields.Trigger: Sale to overseas customer or constructively exported (BMBE/BOI)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "Logistics establishes export" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-document of "documentation for input VAT refund support" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-count of "Accountant includes in 2550M zero-rated schedule" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-485 (ensure controlled execution — VAT-Exempt & Zero-Rated Customer Certification (PA-85.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Audit risk**: Insufficient export documentation disallows zero-rating; mitigated by documentation checklist
System Touchpoints: - Zero-rated treatment; export documentation archive; TCC claim

steps.activity: Trade Sales/Logistics establishes export: shipping documents, BIR-accredited invoice, proof of payment from abroad, BOC export entry
Tax Accountant applies zero-rated VAT; captures export documentation for input VAT refund support
Tax Accountant includes in 2550M zero-rated schedule; claims input VAT refund/TCC with BIR

workflows.name: BIR Tax-Exempt Entity Master Maintenance & Renewal Tracking

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Accountant/AR triggers renewal requests 60 days before expiry" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-schedule of "Tax Accountant audits master completeness and accuracy quarterly" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-485 (ensure controlled execution — VAT-Exempt & Zero-Rated Customer Certification (PA-85.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Lapsed exemption processed as exempt; mitigated by expiry-triggered suspension
System Touchpoints: - Tax-exempt entity master; renewal calendar; reconciliation report

steps.activity: Master Data maintains tax-exempt entity master: entity type, exemption basis (PEZA/BOI/government/educational/housing), certificate number, expiry
Tax Accountant/AR triggers renewal requests 60 days before expiry; suspends exemption treatment if not renewed
Tax Accountant audits master completeness and accuracy quarterly; reconciles to 2550M exempt/zero-rated schedule

fields.Trigger: Single transaction with taxable and exempt items

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "logic for shared charges" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-validate of "validates final invoice tax computation" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-485 (ensure controlled execution — VAT-Exempt & Zero-Rated Customer Certification (PA-85.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Mis-allocation distorts VAT; mitigated by line-level configuration and audit
System Touchpoints: - Item VAT-treatment master; apportionment engine; invoice tax computation

steps.activity: Pricing configures item-level VAT treatment in master (taxable standard, exempt, zero-rated); ensures POS/quote applies correctly per line
IT implements apportionment logic for shared charges (delivery, installation) between taxable and exempt lines per BIR rules
AR validates final invoice tax computation; ensures correct VAT per line and correct ATC; reconciles to GL

workflows.name: VAT-Exempt Sale Invoice, ATC & Disclosure Compliance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-generate of "generates BIR-compliant invoice with required disclosures" (Step 1, already system-executed).
- System auto-validate of "validates invoice format and disclosure completeness via sampling audit" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "IT/AR archives invoices with linked exemption documentation" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-485 (ensure controlled execution — VAT-Exempt & Zero-Rated Customer Certification (PA-85.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Missing disclosure invalidates exemption at audit; mitigated by template and sampling audit
System Touchpoints: - BIR invoice template; disclosure validation; EIS transmission; archive

steps.activity: ERP generates BIR-compliant invoice with required disclosures: "VAT EXEMPT" or "ZERO-RATED" marking, exemption basis, customer TIN/name, ATC
Tax Accountant validates invoice format and disclosure completeness via sampling audit; corrects template where deficient
IT/AR archives invoices with linked exemption documentation; supports BIR EIS transmission and audit
